content: Verified via curl of plaid.com/docs/api/items (primary source, not search-summarised). Plaid's Item webhook set: PENDING_DISCONNECT fires 7 days before a US/CA connection is scheduled to disconnect (PENDING_EXPIRATION is the EU/UK equivalent) -- i.e. Plaid warns BEFORE expiry on a known schedule, not only after breakage. ERROR fires when a connection breaks (e.g. ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED), resolved by 'Link update mode' -- a re-auth flow scoped to the existing connection, not a new one. LOGIN_REPAIRED fires when the connection self-heals, telling the app to clear its warning banner. USER_PERMISSION_REVOKED / USER_ACCOUNT_REVOKED fire on explicit revocation. The transferable shape for Schwab's known 7-day cycle: warn on a schedule before expiry (Plaid's PENDING_DISCONNECT pattern), not only react to failure (Plaid's ERROR pattern) -- Schwab's expiry is deterministic so the scheduled-warning half applies more than the reactive half.
